title: Lottery Scam Advisory
summary: Fraudsters are sending fake lottery winning messages demanding processing fees. Victims are asked to pay registration fees to claim non-existent prizes.
recommendation: Do not respond to unsolicited lottery messages. No legitimate lottery requires advance fees. Report to cybercrime.gov.in.

title: Fake Customer Support Scams
summary: Fake customer support numbers circulating on social media and search results. Victims pay for services that are never delivered.
recommendation: Always verify customer support numbers from official websites or documents. Do not call numbers found in unsolicited messages.

title: Phishing via SMS (Smishing) Advisory
summary: Increase in SMS-based phishing (smishing) targeting banking customers. Messages contain shortened URLs leading to fake banking portals.
recommendation: Do not click on links in SMS messages. Always access bank portals directly through official apps or bookmarked URLs.

title: KYC Fraud Advisory
summary: Fraudsters impersonating bank officials requesting KYC updates via SMS and WhatsApp. Victims directed to phishing websites that steal credentials.
recommendation: Banks never ask for KYC updates via SMS links. Visit branch directly or use official banking apps for any updates.
